title: Homeowners Insurance Liability and Medical Payments Limits by Program
content:
Every Homeowners Insurance policy written by Calloway Insurance Agency carries a personal liability limit, stated per occurrence, and a medical payments to others limit, stated per person. The limits are fixed by the HomeShield program.

## Limits page

| Program | Personal liability, per occurrence (USD) | Medical payments to others, per person (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 100,000 (100000) | 1,000 (1000) |
| HomeShield Standard | 300,000 (300000) | 5,000 (5000) |
| HomeShield Plus | 300,000 (300000) | 5,000 (5000) |
| HomeShield Preferred | 500,000 (500000) | 5,000 (5000) |
| HomeShield Premier | 500,000 (500000) | 10,000 (10000) |
| HomeShield Estate | 1,000,000 (1000000) | 10,000 (10000) |

## Questions the limits page answers

**How is each limit stated?**
The personal liability limit is stated per occurrence, and the medical payments to others limit is stated per person.

**Which programs share the same limits?**
HomeShield Standard and HomeShield Plus share 300,000 dollars of liability and 5,000 dollars of medical payments. HomeShield Preferred and HomeShield Premier share 500,000 dollars of liability but differ on medical payments: 5,000 dollars under Preferred, 10,000 dollars under Premier.

**What is the highest liability limit in the HomeShield family?**
1,000,000 dollars per occurrence, under HomeShield Estate only.

## Example (hypothetical occurrence)

Under HomeShield Essential, one hypothetical occurrence in which two guests are each hurt is subject to a personal liability limit of 100,000 dollars for that occurrence, and medical payments to others of up to 1,000 dollars for each of the two guests.
